readme:
# Rodin Gen-2 Image to 3D
Rodin Gen-2 by Hyper3D (Deemos) generates production-ready 3D assets from one to five reference images.
## Fields
| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | — | Optional text prompt to guide generation. Generated from the images when empty. |
| `images` | image URLs (1–5), required | — | 1 to 5 images of the object. |
| `geometry_file_format` | `glb` / `usdz` / `fbx` / `obj` / `stl` | `glb` | Output file format. |
| `quality_mesh_option` | `4K Quad` / `8K Quad` / `18K Quad` / `50K Quad` / `2K Triangle` / `20K Triangle` / `150K Triangle` / `500K Triangle` | `500K Triangle` | Mesh density and topology. Quad gives smooth surfaces, Triangle gives detailed geometry. |
| `material` | `PBR` / `Shaded` / `All` | `All` | PBR, Shaded (baked lighting) or All (both). |
| `addons` | `HighPack` | — | Optional add-on. HighPack (4K textures, high-poly) is billed +$0.80. |
| `TAPose` | boolean | `false` | Generate characters in T-pose or A-pose for rigging. |
| `seed` | integer 0–65535 | — | Seed (0-65535). |
## Output
- `url`: Main 3D file (GLB unless another export format is selected).
## Billing
$0.40 per request with default settings. Price by option (other settings at default):
| Option | Price |
|---|---|
| addons unset | $0.40 |
| addons = HighPack | $1.20 |
Failed runs are not charged.
## Also on SandBase
Other hyper3d 3D endpoints: `hyper3d/rodin/2.5/fast/image-to-3d`, `hyper3d/rodin/2.5/fast/text-to-3d`, `hyper3d/rodin/2.5/image-to-3d`, `hyper3d/rodin/2.5/text-to-3d`.
